run_preprocess_ef: run the preprocess_ef script to create LMDB files with extracted graph features from extxyz files for the S2EF task
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run the write_images_to_lmdb function to write trajectory frames as graph data objects into an LMDB database
run_main: run the main function to extract graph features from extxyz files and chunk them across multiple workers into LMDB files
run_get_parser: run the get_parser function to create an argparse parser with data-path, out-path, num-workers, ref-energy, and test-data arguments
review_atoms_to_graphs_config: review the AtomsToGraphs initialization in main to understand graph feature extraction parameters like max_neigh, radius, and edge settings
